about: The vocabulary audit's allowlist (scripts/vocab-audit.ts, U21.3): files that are not screen text, and retired words that may stay where they are, each with its reason. An entry matches a hit by file (relative to src/), alias and a substring of the visible text; an entry no hit matches fails the audit.
